transcript.text: In this video, you’ll export your title as an image, a video, or an After Effects composition.
When your title is ready, press Export.
Pick a format. PNG image is the current frame, with transparency. PNG sequence is every frame, for any video editor.
WebM and MOV are videos that keep transparency. MP4 plays everywhere.
GIF is for chat stickers. Animated PNG and WebP give soft edges in small files.
Choose the size: one times is the artboard size, two times is twice as sharp.
Trim crops away empty space. You can add the background colour, or export only the selected title.
MP4 can’t store transparency. For a transparent title, you get a ZIP with the video and a black and white matte.
In your video editor, put the matte above the video and use it as a luma matte.
After Effects gives you a ZIP with a script. Run it, and it builds an editable composition, with each letter on its own layer.
Press Export, and the file downloads.
The window stays open, so you can export another format. Close it when you’re done.
A Still title exports as an image. Switch to Animated whenever you want video.
That’s everything. Have fun making titles!
